readings.title: The Geometry of Qubit Weak Values
findings: p3 Eq1-2 defines the known pre/postselected weak value; anomalous or complex values are established, not our novelty.
p4 limits the later geometric analysis to qubits; no higher-dimensional geometry theorem is imported.
The project flag-state equivalence and source-native finite phase witness are our analytical transfer checks, not claims stated by this paper.
readings.transfer: Test whether a utility observable plus postselection changes the native independent routing/readout link.
readings.limitation: Remaining pages6-18 and referenced original proofs/code unread; no priority or universal quantum-resource claims.

readings.title: QGrAT: Quantum Grade-Aware Transformer for Jet Tagging
findings: p7/12 already place trainable readout interactions inside a joint quantum architecture; generic joint quantum readout is not a new contribution.
p10 injects a product of three pairwise Minkowski inner products via an ancilla. Task motivation is jet three-prong structure, not an independently established NLP premise.
p7 complete classifier remains frame-dependent despite invariant couplings; p10 batch-standardized triple features make evaluation batch-dependent.
p12 footnote says final RZ before Z measurement is redundant. Do not import parameter counts as independently verified usable degrees of freedom.
readings.transfer: Consider task-structured interaction/readout design while retaining the distinction between local invariance and complete-model behavior.
readings.limitation: No full proof/code/experiment audit; unread sections and reported performance not reproduced. Direct quantum-attention near neighbor, not a novelty clearance.

readings.title: Robust Information Bottleneck for Task-Oriented Communication with Digital Modulation
findings: p3-4 specifies probabilistic encoder, a parameter-independent extended channel and receiver, with the Markov chain Y-X-Z-Zhat.
p4 Eq7 trades task information and coded redundancy. Task-driven joint encoder/receiver design is established cross-domain inspiration.
Native signed-utility class-conditional pooling is not automatically this stochastic channel; channel, noise, dimensional and information boundaries must be specified before transferring the loss.
p5 conditional-entropy inequality Eq15 and coefficient handling in Eq17 need separate applicability/algebra audit; no theorem or loss from these equations is adopted.
readings.transfer: Ask what information a quantum bottleneck must preserve for its actual downstream decision, not only state similarity.
readings.limitation: No numerical results, appendices or implementation audited. Source-derived objective not a novel quantum mechanism or task-specific proof.
